definitions.explanation: The way a school refers to itself in formal writing and announcements. Used by the institution about itself, never by an outsider talking about someone else's school.

examples.japanese: {当校|とうこう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{創立|そうりつ}→創立：15353_souritsu⟧{五十年|ごじゅうねん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えます→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: Our school marks its fiftieth anniversary this year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詳|くわ}しく→詳しい：02483_kuwashii⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{当校|とうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホームページ→ホームページ：05869_hoomupeeji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦ご{覧|らん}→ご覧：01408_goran⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: For details, please see our school's website.

examples.japanese: {当校|とうこう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{一人|ひとり}→一人：00630_hitori⟧ひとり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{個性|こせい}→個性：11536_kosei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧にした⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}って→行う：01238_okonau⟧⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧。
examples.english: At our school, we provide an education that values each student's individuality.

notes:
The prefix {当|とう} ('this, the present one') is how an organization refers to itself in formal Japanese: ⟦{当社|とうしゃ}→当社：22449_tousha⟧ (our company), {当店|とうてん} (our shop), {当院|とういん} (our hospital or clinic), {当館|とうかん} (our hotel or museum).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {当校|とうこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{生徒|せいと}→生徒：01051_seito⟧: our students
- {当校|とうこう}⟦{独自|どくじ}→独自：05614_dokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り{組|く}み→取り組み：10403_torikumi⟧: our school's own initiative
- {当校|とうこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{問|と}い{合|あ}わせ→問い合わせる：17737_toiawaseru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧: please contact the school

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{本校|ほんこう}→本校：30456_honkou⟧: this school — also used by the school itself; additionally means the main campus as opposed to a ⟦{分校|ぶんこう}→分校：30457_bunkou⟧ (branch campus)
- ⟦{母校|ぼこう}→母校：14958_bokou⟧: alma mater — the school one graduated from, used by the former student
- わが{校|こう}: our school — warmer and more rhetorical, common in speeches
